description: Give any website or feed URL, get its latest posts as clean JSON. No extra key or account needed. Finds the feed for you (page <link> tags, feed links, 11 common paths) and reads RSS 0.9x/2.0, RSS 1.0 (RDF), Atom and JSON Feed 1.0/1.1 into ONE schema: title, link, ISO UTC date, summary text, authors, categories, podcast enclosure + duration. Only-new polling with since or hours, fingerprint for change checks, warnings for broken feeds (duplicate ids, bad dates). Up to 10 sites per call, ~0.2-2.5 s, robots.txt respected, XXE-safe parser. For news monitors, AI agents, n8n/Make/Zapier flows and podcast apps. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/rss-feed-reader.

allFeeds.description: Read every feed the site advertises (max 5) instead of only the main one

hours.description: Instead of since: only items from the last N hours

includeContent.description: Also return the full item HTML (content:encoded / Atom content)

limit.description: Max items returned per feed, newest first (1-100)

since.description: Only items published after this ISO date/time, e.g. 2026-11-17T08:00:00Z (only-new polling)

url.description: Website or feed URL, e.g. https://www.theverge.com or https://hnrss.org/frontpage

urls.description: Instead of url: up to 10 websites or feed URLs

name: rss_feed_reader
title: RSS Feed Reader API - find and parse RSS, Atom, JSON
